summary_1line: Bhima and allies battle Kritavarman; Sikhandin is struck unconscious, Kritavarman briefly routs the Pandavas until Satyaki arrives and defeats him before advancing toward the Trigartas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima hurls a blazing golden-shafted dart at Kritavarman, which the latter splits midair with two arrows like a meteor breaking apart.
Kritavarman and Sikhandin stand on their chariots firing hundreds of arrows at each other like two suns blazing in the sky.
Sikhandin, pierced by many arrows, collapses unconscious on the terrace of his chariot while his driver rushes him away from the battlefield.
